_comment: Curated exact-noun dictionary for AAC card image generation. Goal: visual clarity for users with language/developmental disabilities and foreign/non-native speakers. Every entry maps a Korean label to a literal, concrete, unambiguous real-world object description (no abstract symbols, no emoji, no metaphor, no invented meaning). Words with more than one common concrete meaning (e.g. 사과 = fruit OR apology) are listed under `ambiguous` instead of `nouns`, and MUST be disambiguated by an explicit, non-empty guardian-provided visualMeaning: picking one of the listed choices exactly reuses the curated scene for that choice, but the choices are UI suggestions, not a strict whitelist, so a more specific literal guardian description is also accepted verbatim (never auto-defaulted, never silently picked for the guardian). This file is read by both server/src/visualConcepts.js (resolution logic) and is the single source of truth; do not duplicate or fork meanings elsewhere.
